title: Feature flag + cohort targeting for Incident Bot v2 diagnostics output
author: Devon Price
description: Summary: Introduces a gated rollout mechanism for Incident Bot v2 diagnostics (deploy context/config diffs/saturation signals) so we can run a limited beta (SRE rotation + selected regions/channels) and safely roll back to v1 output if bot latency or upstream query cost spikes during incidents. Motivation: v2 diagnostics increases upstream call volume and payload size; we need controlled exposure + a kill switch to avoid self-inflicted load during Sev events. Implementation details: Adds a new feature-flag abstraction (DiagV2Gate) with cohort targeting on Slack context (workspace, channel, user group), incident context (env/region/service), and optional allow/deny lists. Default behavior is OFF unless explicitly enabled; bot continues to render v1 cards with deep links. Adds three evaluation modes: (1) global enable/disable (INCIDENT_BOT_DIAG_V2_ENABLED), (2) cohort allowlist (INCIDENT_BOT_DIAG_V2_COHORTS), (3) per-thread override for on-call testing via a Slack interactive action "Enable v2 diagnostics in this thread" which expires automatically after a configurable TTL. Rollback/safety: Adds a hard kill switch (INCIDENT_BOT_DIAG_V2_KILL_SWITCH) that forces v1 regardless of cohort evaluation; also adds budgeted evaluation logging + metric counters to confirm flag decisions during incidents. The bot will fall back to v1 output if upstream v2 context gathering times out, but still logs the flag decision (without leaking any tenant identifiers). Telemetry: Emits metrics incident_bot.diag_v2.gate_decision{decision=enabled|disabled, reason=...} and incident_bot.diag_v2.thread_override{action=enabled|disabled}. Docs: Updates operator notes in /docs to describe how to configure cohorts and how to disable v2 during an incident. Testing: Unit tests cover cohort parsing, precedence rules (kill switch > per-thread override > denylist > allowlist > global), and TTL expiration. Includes a simple integration test that simulates message events from #incidents and validates the correct renderer path is taken. Rollout plan: Start with SRE rotation channels only (#incidents, #eng-oncall) in staging; enable prod for 10% cohort (SRE on-call user group) for one rotation; expand to platform on-call after telemetry confirms stable bot response times and no noticeable increase in diagnostics endpoint QPS. Related: ENG-5428 (rollout + feature-flagged beta), ENG-5425 (Slack interaction reliability/acks).
commits: feat(flag): add DiagV2Gate interface + env-backed provider
feat(flag): implement cohort allow/deny parsing + precedence rules
feat(slack): add per-thread override action + TTL storage
chore(metrics): add gate decision counters + override counters
test: add unit tests for cohort matching + TTL expiry
docs: add rollout/rollback instructions for v2 diagnostics
configuration_notes: New env vars: INCIDENT_BOT_DIAG_V2_ENABLED=true|false (default false); INCIDENT_BOT_DIAG_V2_COHORTS='channels=#incidents,#eng-oncall;user_groups=sre-oncall;regions=us-east-1,eu-west-1' (optional); INCIDENT_BOT_DIAG_V2_DENY='channels=#incidents-ops' (optional); INCIDENT_BOT_DIAG_V2_KILL_SWITCH=true|false (default false); INCIDENT_BOT_DIAG_V2_OVERRIDE_TTL_MIN=60 (default 60). Precedence: kill switch > per-thread override > deny > allow > global enable.
conversation: Miles Thornton (review): Can we guarantee v2 is fully off by default in prod even if cohorts are misconfigured? Also need a clear kill switch for on-call. Devon Price (author): Yes—global default false; cohorts are only evaluated when global is true. Added INCIDENT_BOT_DIAG_V2_KILL_SWITCH that forces v1 regardless of other config and documented it in operator notes. Rafael Mendes (review): Please add a metric for gate decisions with a reason label so we can validate cohort selection during beta. Also ensure we don't log tenant IDs in decision logs. Devon Price (author): Added incident_bot.diag_v2.gate_decision with reason={kill_switch,thread_override,denylist,allowlist,global_disabled}. Gate logs include only channel + workspace + region; no tenant identifiers. Dylan Brooks (review): Thread override action—what prevents it from persisting forever? Also make sure it doesn’t require elevated scopes beyond what we already have. Devon Price (author): Overrides stored with TTL (default 60m) and auto-expire; action uses existing Slack interactivity scope. No new OAuth scopes. Marissa Cole (review): Please confirm UX copy makes it clear this is beta and can be disabled. Devon Price (author): Updated button + confirmation text: 'Enable v2 diagnostics (beta) for this thread (expires in 60m)'. Added 'Disable v2 (beta) for this thread' action for rollback during incident. Miles Thornton (final): Looks good with precedence + kill switch. Approve after updating docs with concrete examples for cohorts string. Devon Price (author): Added examples for channels/user_groups/regions and a one-liner for emergency rollback. CI green. Merged via squash.
release_notes: Internal: Incident Bot v2 diagnostics can now be feature-flagged and rolled out by cohort with a kill switch for fast rollback.
